basic_info.description: Nestled between Balboa Street and Golden Gate Park, this spacious 5 bed and 3 bath Outer Richmond gem blends modern design with classic charm. The main level with high ceilings features an open layout with a newly built living and dining area, anchored by a chef's kitchen equipped with custom cabinetry, open shelving, premium Thermador appliances, expansive counters, and an oversized island. Upstairs, skylights and new windows flood the home with natural light. The spacious primary suite offers a luxurious bath with soaking tub, walk-in shower, dual vanities, an walk-in closet. A second bedroom and full bath complete the level. Downstairs, a flexible family room, three bedrooms,  and full bath provide ideal space for in-laws, guests, or play. The landscaped backyard includes a new faux lawn and privacy fencing perfect for outdoor entertaining or children at play. Ideally located in walking distance to Cabrillo Playground, coffee shops, local dining, shopping, and coastal trails, this home offers comfortable luxury in one of San Francisco's most vibrant neighborhoods.
